title: Fast exothermic neutralization
protocol: A 1.0 M organic acid stream and a 1.0 M sodium hydroxide stream are mixed at equal molar flow. Batch calorimetry indicates an adiabatic temperature rise of 55 C and completion in less than 2 s. Design a temperature-controlled continuous process.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
